title: Salt and Wolf
author: F. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Vesper Nakamura, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
